name: Anonymous Messenger
tagline: Chat privately over Tor with no phone number needed
description:
Anonymous Messenger lets you have private, end-to-end encrypted conversations without handing over a phone number or any other identifying details. It routes your messages through Tor and peer-to-peer connections, so no central company sits in the middle of your chats.

It's built for people who want to talk freely without leaving a trail back to their real identity.
